https://www.caranddriver.com/news/a73924927/trump-administration-new-corporate-fuel-economy-rules-announced/


AGAIN, more control from the Federal govt.  Kudos to DJT for the partial roll back, however, the existence of such standards is in and of itself the problem!

I want V-8, 4 wd truck, with power, and I don't care about mileage!  Someone else may prefer a smallish 4-cylinder economy vehicle.

GREAT!  To each his own. 

Leave the market alone.  Leave the manufacturers alone.  Allow them to manufacture what they chose.  Let the sales determine the winners and losers.

Technology does not have to be forced.  Technology creates its own path.  Forcing standards does nothing but increasing prices.  Increasing prices delays the replacement decision for most vehicle owners, which keeps the overall vehicle fleet age older, and thus less efficient.  In actuality forcing an MPG standard has the exact opposite effect of its stated intent.

The answer, as usual, is LESS GOVT, MORE MARKET FORCES!

Edit:  Cruisin's the Coast 2026, Oct 4-11.   There will not be any economy vehicles on display.
